title: Macro Release Vol Crush
notes: Uses QQQ 30d IVX as proxy for options IV level. A direct test would require tracking a specific short-vol position (e.g. short straddle) across FOMC dates — that requires options chain data and fill modeling. This proxy test is labeled proxy_tested throughout. Verdict: SUPPORTED if mean pre-FOMC IVX percentile rank >= 0.40 AND mean IV drop >= 1 vol-pt AND p-value < 0.05. Event window: 5 trading days before FOMC (pre-window) vs 1 trading day after (post-window). FOMC dates from calendar.py (hardcoded 2024-2025).
